latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of plc-skill with structured PLC development and vendor-aware routing.

- Provides general PLC logic, design, review, refactoring, debugging, and troubleshooting support aligned with IEC 61131-3 standards.
- Separates handling between a common PLC layer and explicit vendor-specific modules when the platform is identified.
- Supports key IEC 61131-3 languages (ST, LD, FBD, SFC) and covers sequence control, alarms, interlocks, I/O mapping, and maintainability topics.
- Includes internal routing for major vendors (Mitsubishi, Siemens, Omron, Rockwell, Schneider, Delta, Keyence, Panasonic, Beckhoff, Codesys) but does not merge vendor rules without confirmation.
- Excludes generic electronics and wiring-only tasks; provides conservative responses for safety-related topics and requires field confirmation for SIL/PL conclusions.
